name: 物质量跟踪 (4OL)
description_en_html:
Overview

With this scope item, you can enable tracking of confirmed substance volumes from purchasing, manufacturing, and sales. Substance volume tracking helps you comply with chemical regulations. These regulations require you to track and monitor the volumes of regulated substances that you import to, produce, or export to a country/region within a certain period. Substance volume tracking is integrated with the logistic processes for purchasing, manufacturing, and sales and tracks, calculates, aggregates, and monitors the imported, produced, and exported substance volumes that result from the processes.

Key Process Flow

  • Create legal entity mappings
  • Create a purchase requisition
  • Convert a purchase requisition to a purchase order
  • Post goods receipt for a purchase order
  • Create a process order
  • Confirm a process order
  • Post goods receipt for a purchase order
  • Create a sales order
  • Add a market assessment (optional)
  • Create a delivery
  • Post goods issue for an outbound delivery
  • Perform substance volume tracking in background
  • Monitor substance volumes
  • Check substance volume tracking status
  • Trace aggregated substance volumes back to the logistics document from which the substance volumes originate

Business Benefits

  • Enable tracking, calculation, and aggregation of volumes of imported, produced, and exported substances on a legal entity level and based on the relevant compliance requirements and tracking period
  • Simplify the comparison between the aggregated substance volumes and the thresholds in the relevant compliance requirements by calculating a substance volume tracking status
  • Support monitoring of substance volumes tracing back to the respective logistics document via an SAP Fiori app
description_zh_html:
概览

通过此范围项目，您可以启用跟踪采购、制造和销售中的已确认物质量。物质量跟踪可帮助您遵守化学品法规。这些法规要求您跟踪和监控特定期间内进口、生产或出口到某个国家/地区的受监管物质的体积。物质量跟踪与采购、制造和销售的物流流程集成，并跟踪、计算、汇总和监控流程产生的进口、生产和出口物质量。

关键流程流

  • 创建法人映射
  • 创建采购申请
  • 将采购申请转换为采购订单
  • 过账采购订单的收货
  • 创建流程订单
  • 确认流程订单
  • 过账采购订单的收货
  • 创建销售订单
  • 添加市场评估（可选）
  • 创建交货
  • 过账出库交货的发货
  • 在后台执行物质量跟踪
  • 监控物质量
  • 检查物质量跟踪状态
  • 将汇总物质量追溯回物质量源自的物流凭证。

业务优势

  • 根据相关合规性要求和跟踪期间，在法律实体级别跟踪、计算和汇总进口、生产和出口物质的数量
  • 通过计算物质量跟踪状态，简化汇总物质量与相关合规性要求中阈值之间的比较
  • 支持通过 SAP Fiori 应用监控追溯到相应物流凭证的物质量
